## Johnson & Johnson to Host Enterprise Business Review


10/27/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 201 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/636242992/files/doc_news/Johnson--Johnson-to-Host-Enterprise-Business-Review-2026.pdf)


NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) will hold an Enterprise Business Review for the investment community **on Tuesday, December 8th, 2026.** During the event, Company leaders will provide a detailed review of the Innovative Medicine and MedTech businesses, highlight how their pipelines are shaping the future of healthcare, and discuss the Company’s long-term strategy for delivering the next wave of growth and shareholder value.


The Enterprise Business Review will include a live General Session starting at 8:30 a.m. ET, followed by in-depth focus rotations, with the event concluding at approximately 3:45 p.m. ET. The program will feature:


- Enterprise overview from Joaquin Duato, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and a financial overview from Joe Wolk, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
- Perspectives on MedTech’s long-term commercial strategy and leadership in the highest-growth markets, positioning the business to lead the next era in medical technology, delivered by Tim Schmid, Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, MedTech.
- Insights into Innovative Medicine’s industry-leading portfolio and transformational innovation fueling both short- and long-term growth, delivered by Tom Cavanaugh, Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, Innovative Medicine and John Reed, M.D., Ph.D., Executive Vice President, Innovative Medicine R&D.
- Presentations and product demonstrations highlighting additional focus areas across the Company’s pipeline, showcasing the depth of talent and innovation throughout the organization.
- Q&A sessions with leaders from the Company’s Executive Committee, Research & Development, and Commercial teams.


Those planning to attend the event virtually can register and view the agenda and speaker biographies[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fjnjbusinessreview.q4ir.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54629258&newsitemid=20261026863108&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=9bc76a919925c9daf14f53702b0cd122) . A replay and supporting content will be posted shortly after the event.


**About Johnson & Johnson**


At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at[https://www.jnj.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jnj.com%2F&esheet=54629258&newsitemid=20261026863108&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jnj.com%2F&index=2&md5=1fc74d0c8efb76ec856ae652f74646df) .
